name: PantryPal
one_liner: Snap a photo of your fridge and get three recipes you can cook right now.
problem: Deciding what to cook with the ingredients currently available in your fridge can be difficult and time-consuming.
audience: Home cooks looking to make meals from ingredients they already have on hand.

features.name: Ingredient detection
features.description: Identifies ingredients visible in a single photo of your open fridge.

features.name: Ranked recipe suggestions
features.description: Suggests three recipes ranked by how many of your available ingredients they use.

features.name: Shopping list
features.description: Creates a shopping list for the few missing ingredients needed to complete suggested recipes.
